intro: The Circle of West Binding is one of several ancient ritual sites scattered across the Arathi Highlands, situated near Thoradin's Wall. Centered around the Stone of West Binding, this arcane ring is overrun by fiery elemental entities bound to the site.

p: Tucked against the rugged slopes near Thoradin's Wall, the Circle of West Binding forms part of a wider network of ritual sites dispersed throughout the Arathi Highlands. At its heart sits the Stone of West Binding, an ancient relic tied to elemental containment. The grounds are swarming with Burning Exiles—volatile fire elementals that relentlessly guard the perimeter, making any approach to the stone a perilous endeavor for travelers traversing the western plains.
